integrity: The proof uses an exact vertex and active-normal classification in the two parameter chambers, the standard outer-normal illumination criterion, the universal four-direction lower bound in dimension three, and direct endpoint lower bounds. The standalone checker exhausts all sign patterns in the symbolic chamber types and is used only as a consistency check, not as a substitute for the continuum proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the three-dimensional cube–octahedron intersection family. It does not classify arbitrary 1-symmetric bodies or arbitrary Archimedean solids, and the fixed tetrahedral illuminating set is not claimed beyond this family. Differently phrased or unindexed prior observations remain a residual originality risk.
title: Exact illumination phase profile of the cube–octahedron intersection family
